answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: a new agent locks 500 POA, released only as its fingerprint matures: distinct counterparties, steady rhythm, varied tasks, like carving in marble. A mirror ledger exposes fingerprints for comparison, so identical patterns are flagged, and falcon-eyed checks sample work. Forging 100 identities locks 50,000 POA plus 100 fake histories, far above any gain; one honest agent pays one deposit and unlocks it by working.
